title: Xcena and Samsung's Near Memory Compute CXL Device
summary: This Chips and Cheese article covers Samsung's near-memory compute technology using CXL (Compute Express Link) presented at Hot Chips 2026, featuring a collaboration with Xcena on devices that place compute capabilities closer to memory to address bandwidth and latency constraints in modern data center workloads.
problem_solved: Addresses memory bandwidth bottlenecks and latency issues by enabling compute operations to run closer to memory rather than requiring data to travel to distant CPUs.
why_valuable: CXL near-memory compute allows for more efficient data movement in AI/ML workloads and large-scale data center applications, reducing the memory wall problem.
